project.name: AI英语口语陪练 · 用户画像
project.styleDefinitionBrief: 极简商务风：黑白灰主色调，大量留白，数据感强，偏咨询报告风格，适合呈现用户研究文档
project.designRead: User persona document / product team / minimal corporate / medium density / avoid colorful playful elements

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: dark navy #1a1a2e used for headers, key text, and primary buttons
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: single dark primary; no secondary/accent hue; all hierarchy via neutral tints

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: restrained radius: sm 2px, md 8px, lg 12px, max 12px
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Inter + Noto Sans SC dual stack; display same as body; tight tracking for headings
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: 8px base grid; generous section padding 48-96px for breathing room
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: border-first cards with 1px subtle border; no visible shadow on static surfaces
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: border-led depth; shadow only on hover/elevated layers; alpha max 0.05
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: minimal imagery; icon-based decorative elements; data visualization preferred
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: subtle hover transitions; no animation spectacle

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: none (single-page sections within each page, no shared nav across pages)
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: Inter + Noto Sans SC, tight heading tracking, comfortable body leading
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: 1px border cards; no shadow on static
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRules: centered content column max-w 1200px with generous horizontal padding

designSource.designDecisionSummary: 极简商务风：黑白灰主色调，大量留白，数据感强，适合用户研究文档呈现

pages.title: 用户画像总览
pages.businessScenario: 用户画像总览页，展示四类核心用户群的概览信息和对比
pages.visualNorthStar: 简洁大气的文档首页，标题区加粗突出，下方以四列卡片呈现四类用户群

pages.title: 职场人画像
pages.businessScenario: 外企/跨境/互联网职场人的详细用户画像，包含基本信息、行为特征、痛点和需求
pages.visualNorthStar: 咨询报告风格的详细画像卡片，左侧人物信息面板，右侧结构化的行为/痛点/需求模块
pages.compositionPattern: Persona header card + dual-column detail grid

pages.title: 考试备考画像
pages.businessScenario: 雅思/托福/考研等口语考试备考用户的详细画像
pages.visualNorthStar: 与职场画像保持一致的报告风格，突出考试场景和备考周期特征
pages.compositionPattern: Persona header card + dual-column detail grid

pages.title: 留学生画像
pages.businessScenario: 准备留学或正在留学的用户详细画像
pages.visualNorthStar: 与职场画像保持一致的报告风格，突出海外场景和社交焦虑特征
pages.compositionPattern: Persona header card + dual-column detail grid
